I Remember" was released as Deadmau5's third studio album on September 2, 2008, through Ultra Records in the United States and Ministry of Sound in the United Kingdom and Europe. The album was released in physical format in November 2008. Prior to the album's release, the singles "Faxing Berlin" and "Not Exactly" were made available on October 25, 2006, and August 27, 2007, respectively. The single "I Remember," a collaboration with Kaskade, was released on September 15, 2008. In the United States, Deadmau5's collaboration with Kaskade, "Move for Me," reached number one on Billboard magazine's Dance/Mix Show Airplay chart in its September 6, 2008, issue. Deadmau5 has since had two more number-one tracks on the Dance/Mix Show Airplay chart, making him the only Canadian to have three number-one tracks on that chart. The album "Random Album Title" was released two years later, in 2006-2008, during which time Deadmau5 also released his second studio album, "Vexillology," on November 6, 2006, through Play Records, and founded his own record label, Mau5trap. The label, along with Ultra Records and Ministry of Sound, released "Random Album Title," which featured the collaboration of Deadmau5 and Chicago producer Kaskade on "I Remember."
